errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the value for the blue sector is 40%. The legend shows an absolute count of 40, not a percentage. This error is repeated for all other sectors, which are also reported as percentages (25%, 4%, 18%) instead of absolute counts (25, 4, 18).
The orange sector is located in the bottom-left part of the chart, not the bottom-right quadrant.
The label in the legend is truncated to "Не мога да преценя (нямам ин...". The description completes the text with "информация", which is not explicitly written in the figure.
The description claims the legend contains percentages, but the legend clearly shows absolute counts (40, 25, 4, 18) for each category.

errors.text_span: Секторите са подредени по низходящ ред на процентите, започвайки от най-големия (син) и продължавайки по часовниковата стрелка.
errors.evidence: The claim that the sectors are arranged in descending order clockwise is incorrect. Following the blue sector (40), the clockwise order of values is 25, 4, and 18, which is not a descending sequence.
